output.reason: The initial design graph spans model/shape, source/evidence/tool, and template/platform/memory/runtime concerns, plus a cross-layer integrity audit. SACG memory truth shows no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blockers, so independent group-0 specialists with a group-1 auditor are the correct team structure.

handoff_rule.accept_when: Model/shape nodes and edges are explicit and review evidence is traceable to the candidate design graph
handoff_rule.on_failure: Return bounded missing-node/edge findings to the shared design graph; do not fabricate model facts or proceed

subtasks.objective: Check that model operators, residual order, attention facts, head mapping, hidden sizes, sequence facts, and decoder/shape constraints are explicit design-graph nodes and edges in the candidate graph.

decision_authority: Mark model/shape facts as present or missing in the shared graph
Propose minimal graph node/edge additions for model/shape facts
Block handoff on unresolved model/shape ambiguity
role_assignment.mission: Independently audit model and shape facts in the candidate initial design graph for cross-layer consistency.
primary_responsibilities: Trace model operators, residual order, attention facts, head mapping, hidden sizes, and sequence facts into explicit graph nodes and edges
Verify constraint.model.decoder and constraint.shape.model are represented without omission
Report missing or ambiguous model/shape facts as bounded findings; do not infer unsupported values

subtasks.title: Review model and shape constraints

handoff_rule.accept_when: All current-run source/material, evidence, and tool-profile facts are represented as graph nodes or explicit artifacts
handoff_rule.on_failure: Return bounded missing-input findings; do not treat unextracted evidence as present or proceed

subtasks.objective: Check that user-provided board materials, quantization materials, sample projects, extracted field evidence, tool profiles, tool availability, and real tool probe results are represented in the initial design graph without omitted or dangling input references.

decision_authority: Flag missing or contradictory input evidence representation
Propose graph node/edge additions for source, evidence, and tool facts
Block handoff when source/evidence cannot be traced
role_assignment.mission: Audit current-run source materials, extracted evidence, tool profile/availability, and input consistency in the initial design graph.
primary_responsibilities: Map user-provided board materials, quantization materials, sample projects, extracted field evidence, tool profiles, and real tool availability/protocol results to explicit graph nodes
Verify source-material and source-evidence constraints are traceable
Flag missing or contradictory current-run input representation

subtasks.title: Review current-run materials and evidence

handoff_rule.accept_when: Template, board, runtime, numeric, and protocol constraints are traceable to the initial graph with no unsupported backend claim
handoff_rule.on_failure: Return bounded template/platform findings; do not infer board AXI/DDR readiness from lower-layer or historical evidence

subtasks.objective: Check that template library, design space, numeric policy, board DDR/AXI/runtime constraints, and tool protocols are represented as design-graph constraints with no unsupported resource-risk or backend claim.

decision_authority: Declare template/platform graph nodes present or missing
Propose bounded graph additions for template, board, runtime, and protocol facts
Block handoff when platform facts are ungrounded or unsupported
role_assignment.mission: Audit template, design-space, board, memory, runtime, numeric, and tool-protocol constraints in the initial design graph.
primary_responsibilities: Check trusted template library and design-space constraints are represented as explicit graph nodes
Verify board DDR/AXI/runtime and memory constraints are linked to deployment/tool evidence
Verify numeric policy and parameter binding prerequisites are not silently ignored

subtasks.title: Review template/platform constraints

handoff_rule.accept_when: All group-0 specialist findings are reconciled and the shared graph has no unresolved missing edge or boundary violation
handoff_rule.on_failure: Block next-stage handoff and route missing/contradictory references back through bounded specialist repair

subtasks.objective: Check whether the initial design graph can act as shared design state for later agent subtasks and checker evidence, with no missing cross-layer edges, broken artifact references, or human-boundary violations.

decision_authority: Approve or block promotion of candidate_design_graph_summary as initial shared design graph
Require bounded remediation for missing or contradictory references
Authorize handoff to the next stage only after static checks pass
role_assignment.mission: Audit whether the initial design graph can serve as shared design state for later agents and checker evidence.
out_of_scope: Changing model or numeric policy without explicit contradiction evidence
primary_responsibilities: Check every constraint node and edge has a resolvable target artifact or evidence reference
Check cross-layer consistency across model, input, template/platform, tool, board, and human-boundary facts
Produce an audit report with pass/fail by grounded checkers

subtasks.title: Review design graph reference integrity
